note: packages/core runs `bun run script/test.ts`, which spawns `[process.execPath, "test", ...]`. Setup gave it only the top-level preload, which bun test never reads, so its [test] preload stayed ["./test/preload.ts"]. Under bun test, Bun loaded tool.vibe as a file asset: `Export named 'CodeModeTool' not found` (a self-namespace re-export), `export 'awaitActivation' not found`, and `Cannot find module '../src/environment/unavailable'` for extensionless imports.

files.packages/core/script/test.ts:
const child = Bun.spawn({
  cmd: [process.execPath, "test", "--only-failures", "--timeout=30000", ...process.argv.slice(2)],
  stdin: "inherit",
  stdout: "inherit",
  stderr: "inherit",
})
process.exitCode = await child.exited
